text.text_excerpt: Super neat little venue! I've wanted to check it out forever, perhaps before they even opened, and finally got a chance to visit tonight (and take my very first improv class!) It reminds me a bit of La Nuit, if you've ever been there, at least in terms of size. The Shadowbox Theater is a bit... nicer, though.

The Shadowbox Theatre is a great venue on St. Claude. There are some great shows that play here - New Movement comedy shows, Acro-Cats, and other stuff I'm sure... They also house classes in comedy and music. There is theater seating using everything from old theater seats to folding chairs and benches. The lounge area is much nicer than other small venues in the city (cough cough La Nuit) where you have to leave the theater to go get your drink. They usually offer beer, wine, and soda for a reasonable price during the shows which is always appreciated. The best part about this venue though is that awesome old drug store sign out front shining like a beacon.

This is in no way a judgement but, bring back the name "Shadow Box Theater"! I know it's in the old pharmacy building, but the new name is hard to spell in a Google search ;-) I've been to about 6-7 shows here and never had a disappointing night. Typically, the shows run $20 or $10 for students. They have a cash bar and sell popcorn. Being a little tipsy for the show is encouraged! I've seen everything from splatter shows where you leave dripping in fake blood, to burlesque, to live cat shows to most recently Antigone. They utilize the space well, no bad seat in the house. I love the simplicity of the theater and their use of local actors/tech. I wish they offered season tickets!
